name: Post a Microsoft Teams message when you get a new booking via Carly

parameters.content:
## Post a Microsoft Teams message when you get a new booking via Carly

**Who's it for**
Anyone using [Carly](https://www.usecarly.com) booking pages who wants their team notified in Microsoft Teams the moment someone books.

**How it works**
Carly has no webhooks, so this polls every 5 minutes:
1. Lists your recent bookings via Carly
2. Splits them into one item per booking
3. Drops any already seen in previous runs (deduped by booking `uid`)
4. Posts a card to a Teams channel for each new booking

**How to set up**
1. Install the `n8n-nodes-carly` community node.
2. Add your Carly API credential (API key from your dashboard at https://www.usecarly.com).
3. Connect Microsoft Teams and pick the team + channel.
4. Activate the workflow.

**Requirements** — self-hosted n8n, a Carly account + API key, a Microsoft Teams account.

**Customize** — change the poll interval on the trigger; edit the Teams message (fields: `title`, `start_time`, `attendees`, `status`, `notes`).

Learn more about Carly: https://www.usecarly.com

Uses a community node — **self-hosted n8n only**.

## 1. Poll Carly for new bookings
Every 5 min: list bookings, split into individual items, then keep only ones not seen before (deduped by `uid`).

## 2. Notify Microsoft Teams
Connect your Teams credential and choose the team + channel for each new booking.
